system.description: The manse is dedicated to the unreal—and can support that unreality. Whether through sorcery, Fair Folk glamour or other magic, the manse can enmesh the people within it in powerful illusions. The illusions can affect all five senses, and will fool anyone whose MDV does not exceed 10. Each scene, the manse may create up to five illusions, which suspicious characters may resist by spending three Willpower points. (This cost drops to 1 if the illusion is shown to be false or it attempts to do something impossible.) Illusions may be people, attacks, traps, darkness, walls, or almost anything else, but they can't fool characters into thinking they're dead.
